direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px Header / 52px GuideStrip / minmax(0,1fr) / 56px DecisionBar; cols 184px StepRail / minmax(0,1fr) FactoryStage / 360px EvidenceInspector at 1366x768; stage at least 55vw and 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before shrinking type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A on #050705, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text as the owner-required exception; official logo immutable in black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect, exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; tabular quantities, time and cost; enlarge stage labels under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops, pulses or glows; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; visible 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries second and final logo placement; StepRail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; GuideStrip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic FactoryStage SVG; EvidenceInspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; DecisionBar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and DecisionBar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Enlarge SVG node labels and option-card text below 11px to 11px minimum; refit stage spacing rather than shrinking type.
Link Certificate 120 and Receiving 80 tracks bidirectionally to their inspector evidence rows with shared highlight and focusable SVG groups.
Reduce opening-story logo panel height slightly so FactoryStage keeps at least 60vh at 1366x768 while preserving the second required logo placement.
Keep ROUTE HEALTH PRE-FLIGHT and INVESTIGATION SOURCE EVIDENCE as separate labelled sections with independent status lines; label the first as nonce and identity health only.
Make the route selector at least 40px tall with a visible 2px neon focus ring and announce selection through aria-live polite.
Enlarge stage option and evidence labels to 11px minimum and raise silverDim contrast on the dark panel.
Keep the selected recovery card visually distinct with pattern plus Selected path text, not colour alone, and keep its typed consent form directly beneath it.
Show exact-phrase progress as 0/27 typed with the target phrase adjacent to the input; keep Accept disabled until an exact match.
Enlarge option finish and cost metrics to tabular 15px so the three trade-offs scan without zoom.
State 3 PROPOSED UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL once in the board header and once in DecisionBar; remove repeated proposal wording inside the agent panel.
Make each proposed task row at least 40px, focusable, and labelled untracked until approval, with owner and due offset at 11px minimum.
Prevent the MAT-ALLOY-B 70 parts route label from overlapping the recovery flow line; offset it above the route with a leader line.
Keep CELL-MILL-2 in preview styling until Apply second shock is pressed; reserve stoppedRed exclusively for the confirmed stopped state.
Make the machine selector at least 40px with a clear focus ring and keep the invalidation consequence directly beneath it.
Add pattern plus PREVIEW WILL GO OFFLINE text on the SVG node so preview is not carried by outline style alone.
Untangle the red STOPPED label from CELL-MILL-2 lettering; place STOPPED above the node and OFFLINE-STOPPED below at 11px minimum while preserving the red exception.
Keep pre-flight nonce and identity health separate from the investigation task, with its own heading, status and Run control.
Mark Split available capacity as CONSTRAINED with cross-hatch and text in the SVG so feasibility is readable without colour.
Keep constrained Split card hatched with its reason visible without scroll, and exclude it from selectable radio behaviour.
Keep PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED in DecisionBar and beside the typed consent form until the exact revised phrase matches.
Fix the red STOPPED overlap on CELL-MILL-2 as in step 6 and enlarge its status label to 11px.
Present Prior tracked work 3 BLOCKED and 3 proposed UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL as two separate groups with headings, so blocked prior tasks and replacement proposals are not merged.
Expand the compressed blocked-task rows to at least 36px each with readable 11px text; use the inspector internal scroll rather than shrinking type.
State Approved revised plan, replacement tasks await approval in DecisionBar centre at 13px for scanning at 1366x768.
Number Verify ledger, Seal encrypted packet and Retain independent checkpoint as a locked sequence, disabling each later control until the prior step completes.
Keep the separate export passphrase field labelled 16-160 chars with character-count feedback and a visible focus ring.
Move Before-After metrics 70, 35h and 48h into one aligned tabular row so proof reads before the evidence controls.
Keep PACKET SEALED summary in DecisionBar and mark every evidence control Complete current ledger with check plus text, not colour alone.
Ensure no official logo appears beyond header and opening story placements on this completion screen.
Give Recovery story complete a distinct completed rail state with check, label and aria-current, matching the other rail targets at 36-40px.
